evals.prompt: Write a PRD for Transcript Accuracy v2, the June 2026 bet to fix transcription in noisy rooms. Save it under the current cohort outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: A PRD following 14-templates/template-prd.md with all 8 sections, cited baselines (92% quiet-room accuracy), OKR-sourced targets (96%), 2-4 personas with file pointers, a NOT building list, DD-MM-YYYY dates, no leftover placeholders.
